name: StickerPeel-TS-TW
title: Sticker Peel Effect
description: A black circular sticker with a white rim and a star mark sits on a dark stage; hovering lifts its top half into a curled white flap you can drag around.
use: A launch page wants a playful, draggable badge or sticker that rewards touch.
avoid: It needs a square image with transparent edges, so ordinary photos peel badly, and width is set in pixels.
a11y: The sticker is not focusable and its images have empty alt text, so keyboard and screen-reader users cannot peel or move it. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A round black sticker with a thick white rim, a dotted inner ring, a four-point sparkle and the words SHIP IT in white. Peeling turns the upper half into a pale curled flap with a soft shadow.
behaves: Hovering peels the sticker back partway, showing a blank paper underside; pressing peels it further and dragging slides the whole sticker while it tilts, then it snaps flat.
customise: Image, rotation, peel amounts for hover and press, easing, width, shadow and lighting strength, start position, peel direction and className are props.
weight: light: A few image copies with SVG filters, a CSS clip-path peel and a GSAP Draggable.
